input.command:
COMPANY_ID="9a7cf1f3-02a7-4751-9cdb-671c9c68edb5"
cd /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip/packages/deploy-cloudflare
timeout 50 npx wrangler dev --no-bundle --local 2>&1 &
WRANGLER_PID=$!
sleep 8

echo "--- health ---"
curl -s http://localhost:8787/api/health | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['status'], d['platform'], d['mode'])"

echo "--- companies ---"
curl -s http://localhost:8787/api/companies | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(len(d), 'companies')"

echo "--- company by ID ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/$COMPANY_ID" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('name'), d.get('status'))"

echo "--- agents for company ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/$COMPANY_ID/agents" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(type(d).__name__, len(d) if isinstance(d,list) else str(d)[:60])"

echo "--- issues ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:8787/api/issues?companyId=$COMPANY_ID" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(type(d).__name__, len(d) if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('error','?'))"

echo "--- projects ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:8787/api/projects?companyId=$COMPANY_ID" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(type(d).__name__, len(d) if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('error','?'))"

echo "--- llm models ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:8787/api/llm/models" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(type(d).__name__, str(d)[:80])"

kill $WRANGLER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $WRANGLER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
